name: Centurion Varro
notes: AC 17 (splint). Centurion. Solid, steady, protective of his men. Fort walk guide in Session 0 prologue.
gm_notes: Objective: retire safely to his farm. Goal: protect his men. Agenda: stay out of political games. Secret: knows Corvinus is compromised and has stayed quiet for 20 years. Will act if given a reason -- not a good argument, an actual reason. Key question: 'What do you know about Corvinus that you haven't reported?'
objective: Retire safely to his farm in Campania.
goal: Protect the soldiers under his command.
agenda: Stay out of political games for his last posting.
secret: Knows Corvinus is compromised and has stayed quiet for 20 years.
